search_audit.query: site:dict.variants.moe.edu.tw 零 漢語拼音 líng 令 lìng 教育部 異體字字典
search_audit.outcome: Search located character-specific Taiwan MOE dictionary records; both pages were opened and their Mandarin readings verified.

gaps: The verified modern readings differ: 零 líng and 令 lìng. They establish current readings only, not an ancient sound relationship or which historical reading of 令 was intended as the phonetic in 零. The prior Baxter–Sagart comparison remains a separate historical reconstruction claim. No official Unicode Unihan record was needed for this resolution because both readings were verified in opened character-specific dictionary entries.
